senses.gloss: f. (cmp. זִירָה, a. סַהַר a. b. h. סֹהַר) surrounded place, court, prison.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:11">Cant. R. to VI, 11</cite> <he>מה אגוז … והס׳ באמצע וכ׳</he> as the nut has four store-houses (v. <cite ref="M00140"><he>מְגוֹרָה</he></cite>) and a court (vacant space) in the centre &c. Sifra Emor, ch. II, Par. 3; <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 6:2">Bekh. VI, 2</cite> (expl. <he>תבלל</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 21:20">Lev. XXI, 20</cite>) <he>לבן הפוסק בס׳ וכ׳</he> the white of the eye breaking through the ring and entering the black; ib. 38ᵇ <he>הפוסק את הס׳</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>, beg.; s. 52, end <he>אברהם חוץ לס׳ ואני נתונה בתוך הס׳</he> (Sarah says) Abraham is outside of the prison and I am placed within it (at Pharaoh’s court). Ib. s. 42 <he>נתנו אותו בס׳ וכ׳</he> they put him (Lot) into an enclosure and took him with them.
